Quick 30‑sec summary before the 3pm QBR:  
Top goals — finish Plant 2 onboarding and reach steady state; reduce/support ticket volume and limit customer impact; and advance/close the analytics-module upsell to hit the expansion ARR.

I want to maintain a warm tone, and maybe I could wrap up with "Let me know if you need any edits," though that adds an extra sentence.
